reasons.body4: Host live audio Stages for questions, collabs and watch parties. Announce one before time with card wey your audience fit share, and listen back to di ones wey dem don record.
reasons.body5: Connect your other accounts one time and post for X, Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, Farcaster and eight more platforms from di DeHub composer. Make TikTok still be where people dey find you while you dey build audience wey be your own.
reasons.body6: Import whole YouTube channel, TikTok, Vimeo or SoundCloud profile, all at once. Price show for you in DeHub token before you pay.

proof.title: Where dis numbers come from
proof.subtitle: Cloudflare measure am, no be dis page
proof.query: Di exact query wey dey behind di chart
proof.edge: Every request wey go dehub.io dey pass through Cloudflare before e reach our servers. Dis counts na Cloudflare own aggregation of dat traffic — di same figures our dashboard dey show. Dem no dey collect am by any script for your browser, so nothing for dis page fit inflate am, and blocking trackers no dey change am.
proof.live: Di page dey read am live. Loading /stats dey call our endpoint, wey dey query Cloudflare Analytics API for dat moment and cache di answer for 60 seconds.
proof.limits: Wetin dis one dey show, and wetin e no dey show: you fit see say di figures dey come from Cloudflare aggregation instead of our application code, and say di query wey dem publish here na di one wey dey run. E no be trustless — we dey hold di API token, and Cloudflare no dey offer any public read of zone analytics. Anybody wey get dem own Cloudflare zone fit run di same query against am and confirm di shape.

definitions.title: Wetin di numbers mean
definitions.visitors: — unique IP addresses wey Cloudflare see dat day. E close to people, but no be exactly di same: office wey dey on one connection count once, and phone wey dey move between wifi and mobile data count twice.
definitions.pageViews: — requests wey Cloudflare classify as page loads, no be images, scripts or API calls.
definitions.bots: — dis one na raw edge counts, so crawlers, uptime monitors and scripted clients dey inside am. You fit see am yourself for di browser breakdown wey dey up top, where entries like "Curl" and "Unknown" na automated traffic instead of people. To filter bots out need paid Cloudflare tier wey we no dey run, and if we quietly subtract estimate, e go make di numbers harder to check, no be easier.
definitions.total: — page views and requests dey add up across di range. Visitor counts no dey sum join for one headline "total visitors" on purpose, because person wey dey here Monday and Tuesday go count twice.
definitions.peak: — di highest unique count for any single bucket for di range, for di same reason: na figure wey Cloudflare really measure, no be one wey dem build by adding counts wey dey overlap.
definitions.resolution: — dat one na Cloudflare limit for dis plan, no be choice: e dey refuse any hourly query wey wide pass three days. Di 24-hour and 3-day views dey hourly; 7 days and beyond dey daily, and no way dey to draw hourly all-time chart.
definitions.breakdown: — dis one dey follow di range wey you pick, but e only dey go back {{max}} days, na so far di per-day breakdown dey keep am. For longer range, di chart cover more time pass di country list.
definitions.start: — "all time" mean every day wey Cloudflare still keep, wey today na {{days}} days starting {{date}}, di day wey dehub.io move go Cloudflare. No earlier edge data dey to show, and old days dey drop off as Cloudflare dey age dem out.
definitions.estimated: — since {{date}}, dehub.io dey pass through one relay server so dat network wey no fit reach Cloudflare direct fit still load di site. So Cloudflare dey see most visitors as di relay one address, and im unique count go fall well-well. For dose days, di chart dey show di page views wey we measure, multiply by di normal visitors-per-page-view ratio of di {{days}} days before ({{ratio}}%). Page views and requests still dey measured direct, and Cloudflare own count wey nobody touch dey inside di raw response wey we link for up.

depin.heroTitle: Yous hardware. DeHub wey dey media network.
depin.heroBlurb: Give your extra storage, bandwidth and compute make e help host, transcode and deliver DeHub content.
depin.heroImageAlt: Small edge-compute node wey connect to houses and creator studios
depin.heroCaption: DeHub keep de original copy. Community nodes add strong backup copies and local delivery power.
depin.earlyAccessBody: A lightweigh, browser-like node dey go live down here. A heavy, always-on desktop node dey be future plan, no go dey yet. No matter how much you dey participate, no guarantee for reward.
depin.optInBlurb: Dis wey dis tier dey run for you inside browser na use local storage (OPFS). Na only dey contribute when dis tab dey open—close im, wey dey stop your node, na open again, wey dey start new one. No need for install, na no thing dey run for background.
depin.rejectedBlurb: Network say no go for dis node's session, meaning it expire while page still open. Sign in again and choose to join — no go lose anyfing.
depin.dhbEarnedThisPeriod: Tokens wey you earn this period
depin.threeJobsTitle: One node, three good work for you.
depin.threeJobsBody: Operators dey choose dem storage, bandwidth na compute limit. DeHub only dey schedule work dat dem machine safe handle.
depin.transcodeImageAlt: Creator workstation for house wey dey give extra GPU compute
depin.transcodeBody: Eligible machines turn up load video go change for different screen size. Every output dey check before dem go send out.
depin.hostBody: Nodes dey keep encrypted or content-addressed pieces for small local cache wey get limit. DeHub origin storage still be the main source.
depin.deliverBody: Nearby people dey share video clips while de normal send path still stay ready as automatic backup.
depin.nodesLeaveTitle: A network dat expect node go leave.
depin.nodesLeaveBody: No community machine dey hold the only copy. Health checks, backup copies and origin backup dey make playback dey available.
depin.originBody: Main source copy wey no dey go and backup delivery
depin.availableReplicasBody: Dey serve checked pieces near where people need am
depin.offlineNodeBody: Dem remove am from routing until e connect again
depin.viewerBody: E dey use peer when e dey, origin when e need am
depin.privacyTitle: Hosts dey store data, no access.
depin.privacyBody: Protected media dey stay encrypted for community hardware. Dem dey give playback keys separately to viewers wey get permission.
depin.protectedContentBody: Subscriber, private and pay-per-view pieces fit dey stored as ciphertext. Node operators no dey get access keys just because dem host data.
depin.publicContentBody: Encryption stop casual people see cache file, but public media still dey watchable through public DeHub player. We no go lie say different.
depin.operatorControlsBody: Operators dey choose disk limit, bandwidth limit, working hours, and na which public content categories dey fit. Removal notice dey trigger cache clear-up.
depin.verifiedWorkTitle: Useful work dey confirm, reward still dey change-change.
depin.verifiedWorkBody: Contribution dey measure through sign receipt, health check, and output validation. Store alone no dey create reward.
depin.deliveryReceiptsBody: Checked bytes wey dem serve to real playback sessions.
depin.availabilityBody: Retrieval checks wey pass and service wey dey reliable when dem give am work.
depin.validOutputBody: Transcodes must pass technical checks and quality checks wey dem sample.
depin.revenuePoolBody: Ef dis awn, na reward budget go dey from platform revenue after epoch close.
depin.noFixedRate: No fixed rate, no minimum return, no APY and no forecast dey. Contribution records na for accounting only, dem no be promise say we go pay. Any token settlement for future go happen for Base and e go depend on who qualify, network rules and the law wey apply.
depin.runningCosts: Run na node dey use electricity, data, and make hardware dey short life. Operator no get nafa, and cost dey big big, no fit match any reward.
depin.safestWorkloadTitle: We build am from the safest work go outside.
depin.safestWorkloadBody: DePin dey first support the delivery path wey DeHub get already. Harder work go follow only after dem don prove say checking dey work.
depin.deliveryBody: Live and video delivery wey peers dey help, with automatic backup.
depin.adaptiveVideoBody: Multiple versions for good play so people can watch even when connection is slow.
depin.desktopNodesBody: Storage wey get limit, bandwidth control and availability wey dem don check.
depin.baseSettlementBody: Claims wey revenue dey fund only after operation and legal review.
depin.faqOfflineQ: Wetin go happen when hosting node go offline?
depin.faqOfflineA: The coordinator go remove am from active routing. Another copy go serve the piece, or playback go fall back to DeHub origin storage while dem dey arrange new copies.
depin.faqCanOperatorSeeQ: No dey like dat. Node operator no see content dey host for dem.
depin.faqCanOperatorSeeA: Protected content dey stored as encrypted pieces and the host no dey get playback keys. Public content still dey open for everybody to watch for DeHub, na so dem design am.
depin.faqHowMuchQ: How much money go get a node operator dey get?
depin.faqHowMuchA: No fixed rate or forecast dey. Contribution wey dem don check fit get share from reward pool wey revenue dey fund after epoch close. Rewards no dey guaranteed, and light, bandwidth and hardware cost fit pass any reward.
depin.faqSoftwareAvailableQ: Node software don dey available now?
depin.faqSoftwareAvailableA: Lightweight, browser-based tier dey come now: sign in and choose yes on dis page, and your open tab go dey like a node while it stay open. Heavy, always-on desktop node dey talk about for future — no dey come yet.
depin.faqInstallNeededQ: No dey need anytin for browser node, just open browser like Chrome, Firefox, or Edge, and use it like normal browser.
depin.faqInstallNeededA: No. E go run fully inside tab for you browser local storage. Close tab, your node stop. No background service, no install.
depin.ctaTitle: Launch only when e safe if something fail.
depin.ctaBody: Origin backup, encrypted protected media and work wey dem don check go come first before any public node reward.
depin.footerNote: DePin participation na contribution service, e no be investment product. Availability, who fit join and rewards fit change.

glossary.fractionsDesc: Post wey dem mint for DeHub go turn NFT wey dem divide into 1,000 fraction, and di creator go start with all 1,000 — 100% ownership of di content. Minting no be by force, e fit happen when you publish or later.

glossary.tokenIdDesc: Special on-chain ID wey post dey get when dem mint am as NFT for blockchain. Minting no be by force, so post wey dem never mint no get Token ID yet.
glossary.tokenIdInfoDesc: Di special on-chain ID wey post dey get once dem mint am as NFT. E dey show for top of di Post Info page for post wey dem don mint.
glossary.ppvDesc: Premium kontent wey require payment for DeHub tokun tokun to unlock. Kreatas set di price and dem dey earn revenue from each view.
glossary.totalTipsDesc: Show de total amount of tip dat post dey earn from viewer, show on Post Info page.
glossary.governanceDesc: Waaka for an’ vote for proposals dat go shape dis platform. Your vote power go dey like how many DeHub token you dey hold.

glossary.thumbsDownDesc: Wa show you no like or no agree wey post dey do. Na dis feedback go help make content recommendation better.
glossary.moreOptionsDesc: Open extra actions like edit, delete, or report post.
glossary.imagePostDesc: Post wey contain one or more picture. Picture dey store on-chain as NFTs wey have unique Token ID.
glossary.audioDesc: Audio post wey you fit upload music, podcast, or voice recording.
glossary.audioSpaceDesc: Room wey users go dey talk, listen, and raise hand to join konversayshun.

glossary.unlistedDesc: Post wey no go show for feeds or search, but anyone wey get direct link go fit see am.
glossary.ppvPurchasesDesc: For pay-per-view post, show am number of pipo wey dey buy access and total revenue wey creator earn.
glossary.fractionMarketplaceDesc: Market tab for Post Info padi wey people wey dey hold fraction go dey list am for sale, and buyer go dey make offer. Dis one dey make trading of content ownership possible.
glossary.makeOfferDesc: Wetin you dey sell? Na fraction of post you get? I go give you 0.5 naira for am.
glossary.txHashDesc: A special name or code for any transaction happen on blockchain. Click wey for see full details on blockchain search page.
glossary.followersDesc: Follow pipo wey dey post, you go see dem post for your feed. Your follower count dey show for your profile.
